constraints.constraint: Router → Controller → Adapter layering per tech spec Section 3.2
Use FastAPI Depends for controller dependency injection
Controller maps adapter exceptions to HTTPException
Upsert semantics: creates if new, recreates if exists (no 409/404 edge cases)
Delete is idempotent: returns success even if not found
TDD workflow: write failing test first, then implement
Unit tests mock FmuAdapter; integration tests use real FMU
FMPy has no native reset - must terminate and recreate for parameter changes
instance_id must be globally unique across all sequence types

interface.name: FmuAdapter.upsert_fmu_instance
interface.signature: async upsert_fmu_instance(instance_id: str, sequence_type: SequenceType, fmu_data: FMUDataProtocol) -> bool
interface.returns: True if created new, False if recreated existing

interface.name: G36Controller
interface.methods: upsert_instance(request) -> CreateInstanceResponse, step(instance_id, request) -> StepResponse, delete_instance(instance_id) -> DeleteInstanceResponse

tests.standards: TDD workflow per CLAUDE.md: write failing test first, implement to pass, refactor. Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests. Unit tests mock external dependencies (FmuAdapter for controller tests). Integration tests use real FMU file with TestClient. Run from project root: PYTHONPATH=.:apps/control-sequence-api-app python -m pytest apps/control-sequence-api-app/tests/ -v
